skin.inForce: arctic-calm (app level, Use skin on, no hub-wide skin)

asset.name: Arctic Calm
asset.description: Soft Studio on Arctic Daylight, classic IDE layout, calm motion. A cool, gentle light look. Themes only: the rest of the look (bars, controls, spacing) stays as it is.
asset.author: AmberX AXF

resolved.note: Slots = look.default.slots, then the skin (arctic-calm design package: themes + extras.slots), then skin overrides (none), then own.slots (nav-menu amber-signature). Own layout setting axf.tokens.layout *.toolbarPosition = bottom beats the classic-ide layout (top).

dark.note: GAP: arctic-calm is a design package turned into a skin by skinFromDesignPackage (runtime.ts), which carries one colorTheme and no colorThemes {light, dark} pair, so skin.mode dark fails (skin-modes skinModeColor throws). The day/night switch asset fresh-day-night names fresh-light / fresh-dark. The new default axHub skin must ship a dark pair; fresh-dark is the candidate, to confirm against the s3 dark shots.

styleTheme.note: opacityGlass 0.7 from the hub axf.tokens.style override beats soft-studio 0.72

chrome.axfChromeNote: No axf.chrome.* (toolbar / tab-group / settings pick) values are stored on the hub for axf-console: every chrome element runs on its shared default chrome-<type>. Per-browser localStorage values were not reachable from this session.
